same_scene_criterion: dHash Hamming distance <=4 and resized 128x128 grayscale Pearson correlation >=0.90, or dHash <=2 with correlation >=0.85; image-level visual screen, not proof of shared patient
patient_independence: Cannot be verified; visibly near-identical images crossed the author's train/test split, so this dataset is supplementary rather than primary evidence of generalization
